source_request:
[러브크래프트 공포 용어 정리](chatgpt-conversation://6ad9bf09-c888-83ec-a092-36fbff61fd93) 에서 조사한 키워드를 바탕으로 시각 의미 데이터, 후보 데이터를 충분히 강화하기 위한 상세한 리서치를 진행해줘. 리서치 결과를 어떻게 반영할지 계획까지 세워줘.
시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
보강하고 다시 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The requester asks for a new photographic test of Lovecraftian horror using the supplied portrait. I read the topic as dread arising when an inhuman reality exceeds human comprehension, rather than a specific named monster or mandatory motif. The randomly selected independent authorial concept is a deep-water tissue sample whose continuous surface opens into an immense interior. A person with the supplied face/hair appearance serves as the secondary witness. The scientific cell, membrane, probe, coat, posture, setting, lighting and camera are replaceable authorial choices. The intended viewer experience is the sudden inadequacy of a small measuring frame; the stopped ordinary probe movement connects that discovery to a human scale. Saved creativity 1 governs later local variation; saved surreal 0 preserves genre-required impossibility without unrelated dream decoration. Effective sensual and fetish are both zero for this nonhuman-led scene.
subject: An unknown presence, authored here as a nonhuman deep-water tissue specimen; a secondary person uses the supplied face/hair appearance.
setting: An ordinary refrigerated marine-biology workbench, replaceable authorial staging.
event: An inexplicable discovery defeats ordinary understanding, authored here at the moment a withdrawn sampling probe pauses beside a specimen that exceeds its measuring frame.
visual_priorities: The small physical containment lattice and the immense continuous tissue interior must be visible together.
Repeated pores and the dark vein visibly connect the near sample to the distant folds.
The reference-guided person and the interrupted ordinary probe movement give the discovery a human scale.
Photographic surface and lighting continuity make the impossible specimen feel materially present.
baseline_prompt_en: Photographic cosmic horror at the limits of human knowledge. The frame records an unknown presence; its discovery defeats ordinary understanding. On a refrigerated marine-biology workbench, a squat quartz observation cell fills the left two thirds of the photograph. Inside it, a wet, pale slate-colored tissue ribbon lies threaded through a square measuring lattice. The near part is thin enough to pin under a small steel clip, with a sharp contact shadow on the grid. Follow that same unbroken surface behind the lattice: it opens into a succession of enormous ribbed folds, each receding farther into a dense black interior, as if the small sample has become a cavern that the chamber cannot contain. The repeated fine pores and a single dark longitudinal vein continue from the clipped foreground edge into those distant vaults, making this visibly one continuous material. The last two grid bars bend away into that depth while the front bars remain straight. At frame right, the reference-guided person is working as a researcher, shown from the chest upward in three-quarter profile. Use the supplied portrait only as face-and-hair appearance guidance for the researcher. Her face has a soft oval contour, large dark brown eyes, a small straight nose and natural pink lips; her hair is a chin-length black bob with wispy separated bangs. She wears a plain pale work coat. Her right elbow stays close to her ribs, the gloved right hand holding a withdrawn sampling probe horizontally above its metal cradle. Her head has turned toward the sample and her parted lips and fixed gaze show the pause before she can complete that ordinary movement. A closed notebook under her resting left forearm provides an everyday counterweight to the impossible depth. Photograph this as a physically present laboratory discovery with moist surfaces, scratched steel and faint condensation. The camera is at workbench height on a shallow diagonal, using a natural 50mm perspective; keep the clipped tissue, the receding folds and the person's face legible together. A cold inspection lamp grazes the tissue from the left, while soft overhead fluorescence holds the facial detail. Restrained gray-green color and quiet exposure let the small containment frame and the immense interior carry the dread.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: Cosmic horror in which an inhuman reality exposes the limits and smallness of human understanding. The requester does not prescribe a particular organism, apparatus, symbol or composition.

Use the directly inspected portrait as face and hair appearance guidance for a depicted person; actual identity, clothing, body, pose and original composition are outside the supplied reference-use scope. Image creation and evaluation are workflow requirements, not additional scene objects.
